stage1_admissibility.purpose: Map short-window symmetric head-pulse admissibility without committed endpoint-state or E_c inspection.
stage1_admissibility.selection_rule: Among grid points accepted for both signs with complete mass and exact no-mutation, select the point maximizing delta_h * duration. Ties: larger delta_h, then longer duration. No endpoint W_profile, M1 or E_c is available to this selector.
stage1_admissibility.no_admissible_rule: If no two-sided grid point is admitted, stop with NO_ADMISSIBLE_MICROSTEP.

stage2_construction.purpose: Accumulate vertical-distribution memory only through the selected admitted micro-interval.
trajectory_pair: PLUS repeated N -> MINUS repeated N -> BASE repeated R
MINUS repeated N -> PLUS repeated N -> BASE repeated R
stage2_construction.configuration_order: outer N in listed order, inner R in listed order
stage2_construction.transition_rule: No direct state mutation or special transition handling; if the first interval after a head switch is rejected, the trajectory is rejected and retained as evidence.
stage2_construction.pair_rule: For each configuration compare only its two opposite-order endpoints, which have identical committed time. Select the first configuration satisfying unchanged H2 water and M1 criteria.
stage2_construction.no_match_rule: If no configuration meets both criteria, H2 disposition remains NO_MATCH and no E_c probe is opened.

probe.repeatability: fresh-process exact replay of full microstepped trajectory and probe
probe.support_rule: valid selected pair plus valid exact-replay probes and abs(delta E_c)>1e-18 native exchange

controls: stage1 pair selection cannot access endpoint state observables or E_c
stage2 endpoint selection cannot access E_c
all failed intervals must preserve the latest committed origin exactly
no retry-budget, temporal-budget, mass-gate or solver-tolerance modification
no post-hoc change of H2 thresholds
all candidates end with H_star through at least one BASE micro-interval
research state preparation does not publish production interface ledger mass
nonclaims: no second MODFLOW state variable admission
no production recommendation to microstep H_c
